info.title: AssetCore Pro API
info.description: REST API for AssetCore Pro — Asset Management & Maintenance Scheduler (factory machine register, work orders, breakdown tickets). Endpoints marked with a lock need a JWT token: log in, then send the token as "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

400.description: name, email and password are required

409.description: A user with this email already exists

post.summary: Log in and receive a JWT token

get.summary: List all user accounts (passwords are never returned)

put.summary: Update a user account (a new password is re-hashed)

delete.summary: Delete a user account — admin accounts and your own account are protected

400.description: Protected: admin account or own account

post.summary: Create a work order — the machine status is recomputed automatically

put.summary: Update a work order (e.g. progress, completion with downtime end and spare parts)
Update a ticket (status, assigned technician, schedule)
